name: Pazham Pori (Banana Fritters)
instructions: 1. Slice the Nendran bananas vertically into long, thick strips.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, rice flour, turmeric powder, sugar, and a pinch of salt.
3. Gradually add water to the dry mix to form a thick, smooth, pouring-consistency batter.
4. Heat coconut oil in a deep frying pan or kadai.
5. Dip each banana slice into the batter, ensuring it is evenly coated.
6. Carefully drop the coated slices into the hot oil.
7. Deep fry on medium heat, turning occasionally, until the fritters are golden brown and crisp.
8. Remove and drain on paper towels; serve hot with tea.
description: Pazham Pori is an iconic snack of Kerala, synonymous with the state's tea-time culture. It highlights the use of Nendran bananas, a staple variety in the region, and is traditionally enjoyed with a hot cup of cardamom-infused black tea or chai.
